== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Bow]] of the [[Silent King]] is a unique and exceptionally powerful weapon constructed from the physical essence of the [[Dreadgod]] known as the [[Silent King]]. Its construction utilizes the creature's bones, tendons, and [[spirit]], with its limbs and grip wrapped in smooth white hide marked by shifting black stripes. The weapon features an invisible string that appears as a trembling cluster of light when touched, and it is paired with twelve arrows crafted from the [[Silent King]]'s bone and fangs. Because of its physical form, the bow establishes connections to [[Icons]], a quality that influenced the decision to bind the [[Silent King]] into this specific object. While it is one of [[Lindon]]'s most potent assets, he finds the weapon difficult to manage within his [[soulspace]] and notes that it was not designed for his personal use. Instead, the bow is intended for [[Mercy]] to eventually wield as she matures. It is considered a one-of-a-kind item made of irreplaceable parts, significant enough to rival other legendary weapons like [[Malice]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Bow]] of the [[Silent King]] is a weapon crafted specifically for [[Mercy]]. It features an appearance defined by black stripes set against white hide and is equipped with an invisible string. Beyond its physical form, the bow possesses a [[hunger]] for knowledge and a drive to consume minds. Its [[Authority|authority]] allows it to warp thoughts, [[dreams]], and the perception of others.}}
